title: Falconer Distance Conjecture in the Plane
exact_target: If $K\subset\mathbb R^2$ is a Borel set with Hausdorff dimension greater than $1$, must its distance set $$D(K)=\{|x-y|:x,y\in K\}$$ have positive Lebesgue measure?
